data.name: Dream Dazia
data.detailed_description: A debut game from Jacob LeRoux, aka, CosmoRetro - grabs nostalgic, classic RPG elements and crafts them into a new game and dream-world adventure that started as a side game in college turned retro-inspired dreams of Jacob's to begin his gaming career with this game starring a female protagonist, Dazia, that gets stuck in her own nightmare. This retro, SNES-inspired RPG called, Dream Dazia, lets you explore the world and conquer it how you please with nearly every item, weapon, spell, dungeon open from the beginning. While navigating a surreal open world of Dazia's subconscious - you choose to explore sprawling maps filled with side quests, and at times, befriend quirky others. Ultimately, there are six elemental temples that you must go through in any order you choose and in multiple ways—systems design inspired from the epic scopes of Breath of Fire, Final Fantasy, Chrono Trigger, and other classic gems, this one goes into a dream and explores those classic RPG concepts, but alone, as Dazia. With 20-30 hours of heartfelt narrative, exploration, and ways to build Dazia stats up -> it's a love letter to the golden age of RPGs, all built in RPG Maker 2003 for that authentic pixelated charm. Choose your own path in her dream!

data.short_description: Dream Dazia is a retro inspired 2D RPG where you explore open-world areas in Dazia's own nightmare. As Dazia - you solve puzzles, explore ways to level up, conquer any of the elemental temples in any order. Experience the turn-based combat, hidden secrets, custom bosses, exciting music and more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows XP/Vista/7/8 (or later)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 1.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 1024x768 resolution in High Color (16-bit) mode
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct-Sound compatible
  • Additional Notes: All Windows should be able to play this game. Linux - some music issues, but works.
